snippet.title: Psychology behind New Year Resolution | Old me Vs New me | Pat-1
snippet.description:
Psychology behind New Year Resolution | Old me Vs New me | Pat-1

Why Most New Year Resolutions Fail? | Psychology Behind New Year Resolutions

Har saal 1 January ko hum ek new version of ourselves imagine kar lete hain.
💭 “Is saal main disciplined rahunga”
💭 “Is baar willpower strong hogi”
💭 “Old me gaya, ab new me aayega”
Par kuch hi dino mein resolution toot jaata hai 😐
Why?
Is video mein main explain karta hoon Old Me vs New Me Psychology —
🧠 Kaise hamara brain calendar year ke change hote hi automatically ek mental reset create kar leta hai
🧠 Kaise New Year Bias hume overconfidence de deta hai
🧠 Aur kyun hum galti se assume kar lete hain ki “New Me = Strong Willpower”
👉 Reality yeh hai ki willpower date change hone se strong nahi hoti.
👉 Habit change ke rules alag hote hain — aur jab hum unhe ignore karte hain, resolutions fail ho jaate hain.
Agar aap: ✔️ Har saal resolutions banate ho
✔️ Motivation aata hai par consistency nahi
✔️ Psychology samajhkar life improve karna chahte ho
Toh yeh video end tak zaroor dekhiye 🔥

• Psychology of New Year Resolutions
• Old Me vs New Me Concept
